priorityList: Use Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks remaining.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan immediately if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord on cooldown.
Cast Grimoire: Fel Ravager on cooldown.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant when you have 5 Soul Shards.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if you have 5 Soul Shards, or at 3+ Soul Shards if Summon Demonic Tyrant has more than 5 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Implosion if you have at least 6 Wild Imps active and the To Hell and Back talent is enabled.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have Demonic Core stacks and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
Use Shadow Bolt as a filler to generate Soul Shards.
Use offensive trinkets, racial abilities, and potions while Summon Demonic Tyrant is active.
During precombat, use Power Siphon and begin casting Shadow Bolt or Demonbolt (if Ruination is talented).
